AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions: Travel app for the user's trips: searching saved itineraries, getting recommended tourist spots, saving itineraries, and booking flights. Operational Patterns: - To tell past trips from upcoming ones, compare the day dates returned by searchItineraries with today's date. Calling searchItineraries without a keyword returns all itineraries in one call. - To plan a new trip, call getTravelInfo to get recommended spots, then pass the chosen spots grouped by day to saveItinerary. - Flight numbers and booking numbers come from the bookFlight result. Constraints: - Dates written as text, such as itinerary day dates, use yyyy-MM-dd format, for example 2026-12-20.
